Launches you through the air for up to 4.5 seconds, draining 22.2% Super Energy per second and granting <pve 90% /> <pvp [25%] /> Damage Resistance. Flying very close to enemies deals <pve 150 /> <pvp [?] /> collision damage.

Hitting a surface or enemy detonates the Super, dealing <pve 180 /> <pvp [?] /> direct damage and up to <pve 8,260 /> <pvp [?] /> explosive damage in a 10 meter radius.

Aftershocks begin 0.75 seconds after impact and deal up to <pve 108 /> <pvp [?] /> damage every second for 4 seconds.

// PvP collision, direct, explosion, and aftershock damage are unknown.
